messages.author: 96e275f43eafb053
messages.subject: Prediction in Small Area estimation
parts:
Hi,

I have set a small area estimation with spatial and time (year) as a random effects.
My dataset runs for 7 years and I would wish to predict for first year.
I usually specify the prediction term as follows when using the mesh.

i.year<-1 # prediction year
A.pred<-inla.spde.make.A(mesh, group=i.year, n.group=no.years)

This is not the case for the SAE. 

Part of my SAE code is 

formula_1<response~-1+fixed_effect+f(OBJECTID,model="iid")+f(OBJECTID2,model="iid",graph="name.graph")+f(YEAR,model="rw1")
result_1<-inla(formula_1,Ntrials=Ex,family="binomial",data=sdata,control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE))

I would appreciate  help on how to specify the prediction model in and incorporate to the full SAE inla code .

Thanks 

Eliud

> formula_1<response~-1+fixed_effect

> +f(OBJECTID,model="iid")+f(OBJECTID2,model="iid",graph="name.graph")+f(YEAR,model="rw1")
> result_1<-inla(formula_1,Ntrials=Ex,family="binomial",data=sdata,control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE))
>
>
> I would appreciate help on how to specify the prediction model in and
> incorporate to the full SAE inla code .

Hi,

if you do not use the spde-stack-stuff (or have these model components),
then you need to define the response as NA and add these ``locations''
into the model yourself. See the FAQ entry on this topic:

http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-How-can-I-do-predictions-using-INLA-

H
